data.body: Held-out validation milestone: standard-tier implementer required two attempts; the first held-out gap was partial/promisor clone refusal, fixed on the same tier. Full oracle is now 7/7 green. Defect-seeded mutation proofs are complete: bypassing the partial-clone guard made the refusal integration test RED, and removing the binary data-block continue made the adversarial framing unit test RED; exact restorations returned both nodes and the full oracle to GREEN. Refactoring litmus passes because tests assert subprocess/ref/byte behavior, not private names or source structure. Proceeding to source review and a no-push rehearsal against a fresh unfiltered no-tags clone of the real tickets branch.
